status: PRE-OUTCOME CANONICAL SCIENTIFIC INSTANCE — BOOLEAN REPAIR FROZEN
scientific_question: Can a fixed-base-model agent use development evidence to select bounded textual policy modifications that improve concealed capability, and does correct evidence-to-target assignment causally contribute to that gain?

task_family.name: latent_operation_adaptation_v1
task_family.description: Four matched task families each contain four hidden fixed operations. Development evidence contains verified input-output examples without naming the operation. Candidate textual policies are frozen before assignment. Concealed examples are disjoint deterministic draws from the same target operation.
task_family.structural_holdout: development and concealed examples use the same latent operation but disjoint inputs generated from prospectively distinct positions in a deterministic per-target RNG stream
task_family.development_diagnosticity: the runner resamples the three development inputs prospectively until the four candidate operations have distinct verified-output signatures; this prevents an underidentified evidence set without using concealed outcomes
task_family.boolean_input_domain_repair: boolean_pair was prospectively replaced by boolean_triple after execution attempt 1 exposed the constructive impossibility 4 < 3+3; candidate ontology remains and/or/xor/xnor with xor/xnor extended as odd/even parity

mutation_surface.candidate_generation: deterministic family-specific candidate pool frozen in runner before evidence assignment

assignment.aligned: target receives its own development evidence
assignment.misaligned: target receives another target's development evidence from the same task family under a prospectively seeded derangement with no fixed points

protected_regressions.rule: a selected patch is applied only if its score on the frozen regression suite is at least the unpatched base score; otherwise the arm becomes an explicit no-op

generation.answer_parser: first stripped output line after removing quotes/backticks and optional Answer: prefix
generation.candidate_parser: exact candidate id or unique candidate-id substring; otherwise invalid selection and no-op

inference.test_family: intersection-union gate using separate one-sided target-cluster bootstrap lower bounds
inference.alpha_split: none; both component one-sided level-alpha criteria must pass

interpretation.maximum_green_claim: Under this frozen latent-operation benchmark and bounded textual-policy mutation surface, correctly assigned development evidence causally contributed to selecting a modification that improved concealed capability relative to the fixed base model.
